summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, attaching a press release and Articles of Amendment effecting a 1-for-25 reverse stock split, effective June 26, 2026. The split reduces issued common shares from ~15.13M to ~605,040, with a corresponding reduction in stated capital from ~$151,260 to ~$6,050. No acquirer, target, seller, or deal terms are involved. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a US Form 8-K for a stock split.
